caption:
IIM B UGAT is tomorrow. One last warm-up from the 2025 paper 🔥

A + B: A is the mother of B. A − B: A is the son of B. A × B: A is the daughter of B. A ÷ B: A is the brother of B.
If P − Q ÷ R × S + T, how is P related to T?

Comment your answer before the solution shows 👇 All the best for tomorrow!

#IIMBUGAT #IIMBangalore #PYQ #IPMCareers #BloodRelations
answer: (b) Brother's son: P is the son of Q, and Q is T's brother (both are children of S)
